criteriaSource: CHATGPT_HANDOFF.md acceptance criteria 1-8 (derived from authoritative workbook fields; Master Roadmap row 327 carries no explicit Acceptance Criteria cell)

criteria.criterion: 1. Implement ExcelDevelopmentControlStore - the ClosedXML-backed IDevelopmentControlStore adapter - under src/Nexus.Developer.Infrastructure/DevelopmentControl/**
criteria.evidence: src/Nexus.Developer.Infrastructure/DevelopmentControl/ExcelDevelopmentControlStore.cs (90,279 bytes, SHA256 6160C4FEA3185EC48701D2934C55D354B4780ECEDD7A2B2363D4AC16CE3D9A80) implements IDevelopmentControlStore and is the only implementation of it in the repo.

criteria.criterion: 2. Implement the full IDevelopmentControlStore contract: all 22 named operations, every mutating operation takes a MutationEnvelope and returns MutationResult<T>
criteria.evidence: Independent count of IDevelopmentControlStore.cs = 22 operations (9 read/check + 13 mutating). Adapter public surface matches all 22 with identical signatures; all 13 mutating ops take MutationEnvelope and return MutationResult<T>. Contract file (Core/DevelopmentControl) not modified.

criteria.criterion: 3. Deliver read + one safe mutation end-to-end, atomically. Concurrency/locking/multi-operation atomic writes are WI-07-0.2.4 - do not build them here
criteria.evidence: Harness: 32/32 checks PASS on a fresh temp copy. RunMutation = validate-in-memory -> SaveAs(temp) -> dispose -> File.Move(overwrite) same-volume replace; failed mutation leaves the workbook byte-identical (harness verified). No locking/concurrency/multi-op atomic writes built; subtree-carry explicitly deferred to WI-07-0.2.4 with a code comment.

criteria.criterion: 4. Read and write against the canonical NEXUS_DEVELOPMENT_CONTROL.xlsx as the authoritative store, honoring Session Protocol append-only rules; never delete or rewrite history rows
criteria.evidence: Canonical SHA256 F52A1A8F... identical before and after all harness runs (not modified by implementation). Append-only probe: all 956 canonical Version History rows byte-identical in the mutated copy, only 9 rows appended (958-966); ADR-003 convention (flip previous Is Current to No, append new record) implemented in AppendVersionHistory. No history row deleted or rewritten.

criteria.criterion: 5. Append Activity Log records using the current 34-column Activity Log schema, preserving the mapping conventions already established
criteria.evidence: Activity Log header verified at exactly 34 columns. AppendActivityLog writes all 34 mapped fields (Activity ID ... Created At). Append-only probe: all 52 canonical Activity Log rows byte-identical in the copy, 12 rows appended (54-65) using the 34-column schema.

criteria.criterion: 6. Reuse existing assets - IDevelopmentControlStore contracts, WorkbookSchemaValidator, WorkbookSchemaReport, ActivityLogMigration, ClosedXML - and do not rebuild any working capability
criteria.evidence: Pre-existing scope files ActivityLogMigration.cs, WorkbookSchemaReport.cs, WorkbookSchemaValidator.cs are byte-identical to the reservation baseline (hashes D9051FCD/E8D05329/DC76E648 all match). IDevelopmentControlStore.cs not modified (only implementation added). ClosedXML reused (single Excel library in Infrastructure, no duplicate spreadsheet library).

criteria.criterion: 7. Stay strictly inside the reserved scope; if additional scope is required, STOP and report SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUIRED
criteria.evidence: All 3 new files are under src/Nexus.Developer.Infrastructure/DevelopmentControl/** (the reserved glob). git shows exactly 3 new untracked files (all in scope) + 1 modified workbook (GOVERNANCE_WORKBOOK, pre-existing). No out-of-scope file, no SCOPE_VIOLATION, no SCOPE_CHANGE_REQUIRED reported.

criteria.criterion: 8. Build and test the change and provide evidence, matching the completion standard set by WI-07-0.2.1 and WI-07-0.2.2
criteria.evidence: All 4 src projects build Release with 0 warnings / 0 errors (independent). dotnet test: 199 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped (independent re-run). Verification harness: 32/32 checks. Independent control-state count cross-check matches store output exactly (636/166/138/0/19/18).
